before: The private React host could display widgets but could not contain native paint elements. Layout skipped content controls around table rows.
after: Transparent React containers borrow original paragraphs, tables, rows, and cells. Layout includes wrapped-row controls and nested cell controls in its boundary records.
reason: The host only moves and restores paint elements. The core fix reads existing canonical nodes and publishes geometry. Neither change writes document content, shared state, identities, or transport data.
